subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Instant
solution:
The correct answer is **"Immediate". **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Instant refers to something happening or coming immediately. (तत्काल)
 
 
• **Example:** The moment I pressed the buzzer, there was an **instant **reaction from the audience.
 
 
 
• Immediate also means occurring or done at once; instant. (तत्काल)
 
 
• **Example: **The patient required **immediate **attention to prevent further complications.
 
 
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Precise means marked by exactness and accuracy of expression or detail. (सटीक)
 
 
• **Example: **The scientist required **precise** measurements for the experiment to succeed.
 
 
 
• Anticipated refers to something regarded as probable or likely; expected. (प्रत्याशित)
 
 
• **Example: **The **anticipated **storm made them cancel the outdoor event.
 
 
 
• Gradual means taking place or progressing slowly or by degrees. (धीरे-धीरे)
 
 
• **Example:** The patient showed** gradual** improvement over the weeks of treatment.
